title: Deputy General Manager - Customer Delight
description:
The DGM Customer Delight is responsible for developing and implementing customer experience strategies across the customer lifecycle, ensuring exceptional customer engagement, hospitality, relationship management, and brand advocacy. The role oversees Customer Delight Managers and drives service excellence from booking to possession and post-possession stages, ensuring consistent delivery of premium customer experiences across all projects. Key Responsibilities 1. Customer Experience Strategy & Leadership Develop and implement customer delight and engagement strategies across projects. Establish service standards, customer experience frameworks, and hospitality protocols. Drive customer-centric culture across departments. Ensure consistency in customer experience at every touchpoint. 2. Team Management & Supervision Lead, mentor, and supervise Customer Delight Managers and support teams. Set performance objectives and monitor team KPIs. Conduct periodic performance reviews and capability-building initiatives. Ensure adequate manpower planning and resource allocation. 3. Customer Lifecycle Management Oversee customer engagement activities from booking to possession and beyond. Monitor customer satisfaction and proactively address service gaps. 4. Customer Engagement & Relationship Programs Conceptualize and execute customer engagement initiatives, loyalty programs, and relationship-building activities. Oversee customer events, milestone celebrations, festive campaigns, and community engagement programs. Strengthen emotional connect and brand loyalty among customers. 5. Hospitality & Premium Service Delivery Establish high standards of hospitality during customer visits and interactions. Ensure premium customer experiences during agreement signing, site visits, and possession ceremonies. Monitor execution of personalized gifting and customer appreciation initiatives. 6. Customer Feedback & Service Excellence Monitor customer satisfaction scores and feedback mechanisms. Analyse customer feedback, complaints, and service trends. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance customer experience. 7. Vendor & Event Management Manage agencies, event partners, hospitality vendors, and gifting partners. Negotiate contracts and ensure cost-effective execution of customer engagement initiatives. Monitor vendor performance and service quality. 8. Reporting & MIS Review customer experience dashboards, engagement reports, and MIS. Present customer satisfaction trends and improvement plans to senior management. Track and monitor customer delight KPIs across projects. Required Skills & Competencies Leadership and team management Customer experience and relationship management Hospitality and service excellence Strategic planning and execution Event and engagement management Stakeholder management Strong communication and presentation skills Customer grievance handling and escalation management Data analysis and MIS reporting Vendor management and negotiation Qualification Bachelor's Degree in Management, Hospitality, Marketing, Business Administration, or related field. MBA / PGDM preferred.

Key Skills: Customer Retention,Client Success,Customer delight,Client,General,Customer management,Management,Retention
